parameters.subject: Invoice Batch Processing Summary

parameters.content:
## PDF Invoice Batch Processor

Upload multiple PDF invoices via webhook.
OCR extracts text, Code node parses invoice fields (number, date, total, vendor).
Results logged to Google Sheets, summary emailed via Gmail.

**Setup:**
1. Configure OCR API credentials (e.g., ocr.space API key)
2. Set Google Sheets document ID
3. Set Gmail credentials
4. POST PDFs to webhook URL
